item.title: Trump’s Top Gaza Official Says Israel Is Jeopardizing the Cease-Fire
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov, the Board of Peace’s high representative for Gaza, criticized Israel for its ongoing strikes on what it says are Hamas targets, after it rejected a plan to disarm the group.

item.title: What to Know About Bank Melli, Singled Out in U.S. Call for Economic War
item.description: Bank Melli, Iran’s largest lender, already faces sanctions that severely limit its ability to operate abroad. Every foreign branch must be shut down, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said.

item.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Scour Himalayan Valleys for Survivors After Deadly Flood
item.description: More than 1,300 people were missing in Nepal and the Tibet region of China after a torrent of mud, water and ice swept away villages and bridges, killing at least 168.

item.title: Ancient Lebanese Treasures Take a Journey From Modern-Day Conflict
item.description: Artifacts from Byblos have been on display in Paris in a show that highlights how modern-day conflict in the Middle East imperils the cultural heritage of the region.

item.title: ‘A Huge Paradox’: Nepal Region Hit by Flood Is Known for Development and Disasters
item.description: The region has experienced an economic boom even as natural disasters have repeatedly struck, including a flood that killed more than 160 people on Wednesday.

item.title: Yayoi Kusama, Japanese Pop Artist Known for Polka-Dot Paintings, Dies at 97
item.description: The Japanese artist’s polka-dot covered paintings, phallic sculptures and public performances caused a stir in New York City and Europe in the 1960s.

item.title: U.S. ‘Economic D-Day’ Targets More Than Just Iranian Oil
item.description: The United States threatened sanctions for any country or entity that engages with Iran’s gold, digital assets, aviation, shipping and tech industries. Here’s why that matters.

item.title: Ukraine’s Most Potent Weapon: The Software Orchestrating Its Drone Army
item.description: The Delta system pulls together battlefield data to identify targets, creating a miles-wide “kill zone.” The technology is credited with helping to cut Russian advances to a near standstill.

item.title: Canadians Stand Their Ground Amid New Trump Tariffs and Expanding U.S.-Canada Trade War
item.description: Business owners are preparing for financial pain after the latest U.S.-Canada trade talks collapsed. But many Canadians are embracing a show of resistance.
